free.question: Is StartFast really free?
free.answer: We offer both free and pro versions. The free version includes all essential features. The Pro version adds internationalization, role-based access, analytics, and premium UI components.

stack.question: What tech stack does StartFast use?
stack.answer: StartFast is built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Better-Auth for authentication, Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL, Stripe for payments, and Resend for emails.

typescript.question: Do I need to know TypeScript?
typescript.answer: While TypeScript knowledge helps, the code is well-documented and follows common patterns. If you know JavaScript, you can work with the codebase and learn TypeScript along the way.

database.question: Can I use a different database?
database.answer: Yes! While we use PostgreSQL by default with Drizzle ORM, you can easily switch to MySQL, SQLite, or other databases supported by Drizzle. Just update the configuration and schema.

deploy.question: How do I deploy StartFast?
deploy.answer: StartFast works great with Vercel (recommended), but you can deploy to any platform that supports Next.js, including Railway, Render, AWS, or your own server.

pro.question: What's included in the Pro version?
pro.answer: Pro includes internationalization (7+ languages), role-based access control, team invitations, advanced analytics with Posthog, blog system, Playwright tests, CI/CD workflows, and premium UI components.

support.question: How do I get support?
support.answer: For free users, we have a GitHub Discussions community where you can ask questions. Pro users get access to priority email support and a private Discord channel.

customize.question: Can I customize the design?
customize.answer: Absolutely! The UI is built with Tailwind CSS, making it easy to customize colors, spacing, and components. You can modify the tailwind.config.ts to match your brand.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: Welcome to LoveShow. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we look after your personal data and tell you about your privacy rights.

dataCollection.intro: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you:
items: Identity Data: name, username
Contact Data: email address
Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device information
Usage Data: information about how you use our website and services

dataUsage.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.intro: We use your personal data to:
items: Provide and maintain our service
Notify you about changes to our service
Provide customer support
Monitor the usage of our service
Detect, prevent and address technical issues

dataSecurity.title: 4. Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We have implemented appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used, or accessed in an unauthorized way. We limit access to your personal data to those employees and partners who have a business need to know.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights
rights.content: Under certain circumstances, you have rights under data protection laws in relation to your personal data, including the right to access, correct, erase, restrict, or object to processing of your personal data.

acceptableUse.title: 7. Acceptable Use & Prohibited Content
acceptableUse.intro: LoveShow is an AI-powered creative platform focused on romantic expression and couple memories. To keep the platform safe for everyone, the following content is strictly prohibited when using any AI generation feature — including 520 copywriting, couple photos, couple avatars, emotional analysis, love memoir, couple music, AI portraits, and ID photos:
items: NSFW, sexually explicit, pornographic, suggestive, nude, or adult content of any kind.
Any sexualized, exposed, or exploitative content involving minors. Such requests trigger immediate account termination.
Hate speech, discrimination, harassment, or content targeting protected groups.
Gore, extreme violence, self-harm, suicide promotion, or terrorism-related content.
Deepfakes or misleading impersonation of real people (public figures or private individuals).
Illegal activities, fraud, drugs, weapons, explosives, or other content endangering public safety.
Photos of people you do not have the legal right to use, including non-consensual face images of others.
Attempts to bypass content moderation, jailbreak our safety systems, or attack our infrastructure.
acceptableUse.moderation: To enforce these rules, every prompt-based generation endpoint on LoveShow is gated by the Creem Moderation API. Prompts that violate our content policy are rejected before they reach any model and never produce output. Repeated violations may result in warnings, feature restrictions, or termination of your account at our sole discretion.
acceptableUse.report: If you encounter abuse or prohibited content, please report it to noreply@loveshow.life.
